import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#3498db'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=bmi, alpha=0.6, s=50, 
                c=bmi_colors.get(bmi, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Stress Level vs Sleep Quality with Sleep Disorder indication
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df['Has Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()
colors = df['Has Sleep Disorder'].map({True: '#e74c3c', False: '#3498db'})
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=colors, alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Stress Level vs Sleep Quality', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Create custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#3498db', alpha=0.6, label='No Sleep Disorder'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#e74c3c', alpha=0.6, label='Has Sleep Disorder')]
ax2.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 3: Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax3.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.axvline(x=df['Sleep Duration'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Overall Avg: {df["Sleep Duration"].mean():.1f}h')
ax3.legend(loc='lower right')
for i, v in enumerate(occupation_sleep.values):
    ax3.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Physical Activity vs Daily Steps with Age as color
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
scatter4 = ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                       c=df['Age'], cmap='plasma', alpha=0.7, s=50)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps (colored by Age)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter4, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
